title: 24" Dishwasher with Stemware Shield and 360° Max Jets Third Rack
sub: PrintShield stainless only, bar handle, top controls
lead: A 44 dBA KitchenAid with a 7.25 cu. ft. tub, a third rack whose jets spin all the way around, and a filter that cleans itself. KitchenAid sells it only through independent dealers like Wilson, and it comes in PrintShield stainless only.

features.name: 360° Max Jets third rack
features.line: The third rack has its own jets that spin all the way around, so mugs, pint glasses and cereal bowls come out clean inside and out. Water Repellent Tech helps it shed droplets.

features.name: Stemware Shield
features.line: A protected zone in the middle rack, with stemware clips, holds wine glasses and flutes steady through the wash.

features.name: 50+ wash jets on five arms
features.line: More than fifty jets on five wash arms reach all three racks, so dishes go in without a rinse first.

features.name: Filtration that cleans itself
features.line: The filter catches food as it washes and clears itself as it drains. There is no filter to pull out and rinse.

features.name: ProDry with door-open drying
features.line: A heating element warms the air to dry the load, then the door opens on its own to let the steam out. ProDry Max adds time when a load needs more.

also: 7.25 cu. ft. MaxTub, with room for 10 more glasses and mugs than KitchenAid's 224 models
Express Wash, done in just over an hour
ProWash, which reads the load and sets time and temperature to match
